preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix is a list of lists representing a rectangular grid.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) >= 1 and all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix has at least one row and all rows have the same length (rectangular).

preconditions.expression: all(cell in (0, 1) for row in matrix for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix contains either 0 (landmine) or 1 (safe).
The dimensions R and C are between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 1 and return_value == min((len(path) for path in all_valid_paths(matrix)), default=float('inf')) if any(all_valid_paths(matrix)) else -1)
postconditions.description: If a valid path exists, return the length of the shortest path (number of cells visited); otherwise return -1. A valid path starts at any cell in the first column, ends at any cell in the last column, moves only to adjacent non-diagonal cells, and never visits a landmine (0) or any cell adjacent to a landmine.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 1 and return_value <= len(matrix) * len(matrix[0]))
postconditions.description: If a path exists, the returned length is a positive integer not exceeding the total number of cells in the matrix.
